problem_description: I need an estimation of a house's value on Nantucket. The house has fallen into disrepair and has historical significance. Can you, as an experienced real estate agent, write a python function to estimate the value of this house considering its year of construction, current condition, and the owner's intention?The signature of the function is: def estimate_house_value(year_built, current_condition, owner_intention, historical_significance)
